description: Greetings, essentials, and first verbs — the foundation of Spanish 101.

questions.q: How do you say 'hello' in Spanish?

questions.explain: Buenos días = good morning. Buenas noches = good night.
Gracias = thank you. De nada = you're welcome.
Me llamo = 'I call myself' → my name is.
el = the (masculine singular). la = feminine singular.
questions.q: Which is the correct word for 'the' (masculine singular)?

questions.explain: Por favor = please. Perdón/lo siento = sorry.
Estoy (estar) + cansado = I am tired. Temporary states use estar.
-o ending = yo (I) form: hablo = I speak.
¿Dónde está…? = Where is…? An essential traveler phrase.
agua = water (feminine noun, but uses 'el' singular: el agua).
Mañana = tomorrow, or 'morning' (en la mañana = in the morning).
Adiós = goodbye. Hasta luego = see you later.
Spanish uses 'tener' (to have) for hunger/thirst/age: tengo hambre = I'm hungry.
Masculine plural: el → los, add -s: los libros.
questions.q: The correct plural of 'el libro' (the book) is…

questions.explain: ¿Hablas inglés? = Do you speak English? (tú form).
